name: MonarchLineItemsEditor
title: LineItemsEditor
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of rows, each in an androidx.compose.material3.SwipeToDismissBox (swipe toward the start removes); MonarchTextField, MonarchNumberInput and MonarchCurrencyInput fields, MonarchMoney amounts, MonarchButton; androidx.compose.material3.SingleChoiceSegmentedButtonRow for the discount kind and MonarchSelect (ExposedDropdownMenuBox) for preset tax rates; a polite live region for announcements
summary: Editable invoice, quote or proposal rows (description, quantity, unit price) with each row's amount and an optional discount, tax and total computed exactly in BigDecimal and kept in minor units.
whenToUse: To create or edit the billable rows of an invoice, quote, proposal or purchase order inside the app's scrolling form, or to show the rows of a sent document read-only with the same totals.
whenNotToUse: For a finished invoice laid out as a document, use MonarchInvoiceView. For payroll lines that are calculated, not typed, use MonarchPayslipView. For editable tables of non-monetary data, use MonarchDataTable.
api: @ExperimentalMonarchApi @Composable fun MonarchLineItemsEditor(items: List<MonarchLineItem>, onItemsChange: (List<MonarchLineItem>) -> Unit, currencyCode: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, taxRate: BigDecimal? = null, onTaxRateChange: ((BigDecimal) -> Unit)? = null, taxRateOptions: List<MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption> = emptyList(), discount: MonarchLineItemsDiscount? = null, onDiscountChange: ((MonarchLineItemsDiscount) -> Unit)? = null, error: String? = null, minimumItems: Int = 0, required: Boolean = false, readOnly: Boolean = false, enabled: Boolean = true, showTotals: Boolean = true, labels: MonarchLineItemsEditorLabels = MonarchLineItemsEditorLabels(), makeItem: (() -> MonarchLineItem)? = null)
class MonarchLineItem(id: String = UUID.randomUUID().toString(), description: String = "", quantity: BigDecimal? = BigDecimal.ONE, unitPrice: BigDecimal? = null)

class MonarchLineItemsTotals(items: List<MonarchLineItem>, currencyCode: String, taxRate: BigDecimal? = null, discount: MonarchLineItemsDiscount? = null) { val lines: List<Long>; val subtotal: Long; val discount: Long; val tax: Long; val total: Long }

class MonarchLineItemsEditorLabels(label: String? = null, item: ((number: Int) -> String)? = null, description: String? = null, quantity: String? = null, unitPrice: ((currencyCode: String) -> String)? = null, amount: String? = null, descriptionPlaceholder: String? = null, addItem: String? = null, remove: String? = null, removeItem: ((number: Int, description: String) -> String)? = null, empty: String? = null, added: ((number: Int) -> String)? = null, removed: ((number: Int) -> String)? = null, subtotal: String? = null, discount: String? = null, discountType: String? = null, percentOption: String? = null, tax: ((rate: String) -> String)? = null, taxRate: String? = null, total: String? = null, required: String? = null, quantityTimesPrice: ((quantity: String, unitPrice: String) -> String)? = null)

options.name: items
options.description: The rows: an id, a description and a BigDecimal quantity and unit price (null while a field is empty, counted as zero).

options.name: onItemsChange
options.description: Called with the whole new list after an edit, an addition or a removal. The editor keeps no rows of its own.

options.name: currencyCode
options.description: The ISO 4217 code of the document: the symbol, the unit price heading and the minor unit (USD 2, JPY 0, KWD 3). The editor never converts.

options.name: taxRate
options.description: The tax as a percentage of the discounted subtotal (18 for 18%). null for no tax row.

options.name: onTaxRateChange
options.description: Makes the tax rate editable in the totals (iOS isTaxRateEditable with a Binding): a menu of taxRateOptions or a number field.

options.name: taxRateOptions
options.description: Preset rates offered in a menu when the rate is editable. Empty for a typed percentage.

options.name: discount
options.description: A percentage or an amount off the subtotal, capped at it. null for no discount row.

options.name: onDiscountChange
options.description: Makes the discount's value (number or currency field) and kind (segmented buttons) editable (iOS isDiscountEditable with a Binding).

options.name: error
options.description: An error for the whole list, such as "Add at least one item", shown under the rows in the danger text color and announced politely.

options.name: minimumItems
options.description: Rows cannot be removed below this count.

options.name: required
options.description: An asterisk after the heading, read as "Required".

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Rows as text (description and "12 × $95.00") without fields, buttons or swipe, for a sent document.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether anything can be changed. When off the fields and buttons are disabled, rows cannot be swiped and the rate editors are not shown.

options.name: showTotals
options.description: Whether the subtotal, discount, tax and total are shown.

options.name: makeItem
options.description: Builds the row added by Add item. Default: an empty row of one unit with a random UUID.

states.name: editing
states.description: Each row has a header ("Item n" and its amount) with a Remove button, the description field, and the quantity and unit price fields side by side (stacked from font scale 1.3). Add item follows the rows.

states.name: empty
states.description: "No items yet. Add one to start." in place of the rows; totals are zero.

states.name: error
states.description: The error under the rows in the danger text color, in a polite live region.

states.name: read-only
states.description: Rows are text; no fields, add, remove or swipe; the discount and tax rates are written in their titles ("Tax (18%)").

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled = false every field and button is disabled, rows cannot be swiped and the rate editors are hidden.

states.name: at the minimum
states.description: Remove buttons are disabled and rows cannot be swiped.

appearance: Rows sit on the surface color divided by subtle borders. Row headers are the muted label style with the amount in the default text color; fields are the Monarch field surface and border; the required marker and the error are the danger text color; the swipe background is the danger subtle surface with danger text; the total row is the strong body style below a divider. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the same roles.
platformNotes: A Column, not the planned LazyColumn: the editor sits inside the app's own scrolling form (as iOS uses Sections inside a Form), and a LazyColumn nested in a vertically scrolling parent cannot be measured; invoices have tens of rows, not thousands. The web table becomes the phone pattern of one block per row. Rows are removed with the Remove button or the Material 3 swipe toward the start. Numbers are typed in MonarchNumberInput and MonarchCurrencyInput, which read the text when the field loses focus or on Done and flag text that is not a number, so there is no web parseDecimal; values are BigDecimal and the unit price is kept to the currency's decimals by MonarchCurrencyInput (minor units). Enter does not add a row and focus does not move to a new row; additions and removals are announced instead, as on iOS. Hoisted callbacks (onItemsChange, onTaxRateChange, onDiscountChange) replace the iOS Bindings and is-editable flags; required, readOnly and enabled replace isRequired, isReadOnly and .disabled. Monarch bundles no icons, so Add item and Remove are text buttons and the error has no icon. Marked experimental, as a billing pattern, until a Rook app adopts it. computeLineItemTotals is MonarchLineItemsTotals.
accessibility: The heading is a heading, read as "Line items, Required" when required.
Each row starts with a heading read as "Item 2, Amount $1,140.00".
The description, quantity and unit price fields are named by their visible labels and keep the behavior of MonarchTextField, MonarchNumberInput and MonarchCurrencyInput.
The Remove button is read as "Remove item 2: Design hours" and has a 48dp target; the swipe background is hidden from TalkBack because the button does the same.
Adding and removing a row is announced through a polite live region ("Added item 3", "Removed item 2"), and so is the error.
Each totals row is one element read as its title and amount, such as "Total, $2,174.74".
edgeCases: Each row is rounded to the minor unit half away from zero (1 × 1.005 USD is $1.01) and totals are sums of whole minor units, so the total equals the rows shown; ten rows of 0.10 make exactly 1.00.
A discount larger than the subtotal, or over 100%, is capped at the subtotal; zero or a negative discount takes nothing off; a negative subtotal gets no discount.
Empty quantity or price fields count as zero.
A long description wraps; the description field is multi-line.
Rows are matched by id: give every row a unique, stable id.
A unit price with more decimals than the currency is shown rounded in its field but counted exactly in the totals until it is edited.

examples.title: Invoice with discount and preset tax rates
examples.webExample: Invoice with discount and preset tax rates
examples.template:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchLineItemsEditor(
    items = items,
    onItemsChange = { items = it },
    currencyCode = {{currency}},
    taxRate = taxRate,
    onTaxRateChange = { taxRate = it },
    taxRateOptions = listOf(
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("{{taxRateOptions.0.value|raw}}"), {{taxRateOptions.0.label}}),
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("{{taxRateOptions.1.value|raw}}"), {{taxRateOptions.1.label}}),
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("{{taxRateOptions.2.value|raw}}"), {{taxRateOptions.2.label}}),
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("{{taxRateOptions.3.value|raw}}"), {{taxRateOptions.3.label}}),
    ),
    discount = discount,
    onDiscountChange = { discount = it },
    required = true,
    labels = MonarchLineItemsEditorLabels(quantity = "Qty"),
)
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchLineItemsEditor(
    items = items,
    onItemsChange = { items = it },
    currencyCode = "USD",
    taxRate = taxRate,
    onTaxRateChange = { taxRate = it },
    taxRateOptions = listOf(
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("0"), "No tax"),
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("5"), "5%"),
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("12"), "12%"),
        MonarchLineItemsTaxRateOption(BigDecimal("18"), "18%"),
    ),
    discount = discount,
    onDiscountChange = { discount = it },
    required = true,
    labels = MonarchLineItemsEditorLabels(quantity = "Qty"),
)

examples.title: A sent invoice, read-only
examples.code:
@OptIn(ExperimentalMonarchApi::class)
MonarchLineItemsEditor(
    items = listOf(MonarchLineItem("1", "Hosting", BigDecimal(3), BigDecimal("24.50"))),
    onItemsChange = {},
    currencyCode = "EUR",
    taxRate = BigDecimal(19),
    readOnly = true,
)

examples.title: Totals for saving
examples.code:
val totals = MonarchLineItemsTotals(
    listOf(MonarchLineItem(quantity = BigDecimal(3), unitPrice = BigDecimal("24.50"))),
    currencyCode = "USD",
    taxRate = BigDecimal(18),
)
Text("Total in cents: ${totals.total}")
